_comment: Payload manifest for the host-side cache (see cache/README.md).
Each entry declares WHERE a payload comes from, so nothing large has to be
committed to git. 'source' is one of:
media    - extracted from an already-cached payload (e.g. the MECM media)
manual   - no stable public URL; the user stages it once (see 'howto')
'sha256' is null until pinned. Run 'lab.ps1 deps -Pin' after a successful
fetch to record the observed hash; from then on every fetch is verified.
Hashes are deliberately NOT guessed - an unverifiable hash is worse than none.
'profiles' lists which deployment tiers need the payload, so 'core' users

deps.description: Sysinternals PsExec - runs provisioning steps under a real SYSTEM/admin token
Legacy LAPS (AdmPwd.PS) - extends the schema with ms-Mcs-AdmPwd for Chain 7
deps.howto: Microsoft retired the direct link for legacy LAPS. Download LAPS.x64.msi from the page above once and drop it at cache/tools/LAPS.x64.msi.

deps.description: .NET 3.5 offline SxS source - lets install-dep-roles.ps1 skip Windows Update
deps.howto: These cabs ship on the Windows Server 2019 ISO under sources\sxs and have no standalone download. Copy microsoft-windows-netfx3-ondemand-package~*.cab from the ISO into cache/netfx3/. Only the 'full' profile needs this.

deps.description: MECM/ConfigMgr evaluation installer (~1.2 GB), self-extracts to the install media
deps.note: Stays under MECM_Setup rather than cache/: install-mecm.ps1 anchors its whole media tree (Media/, Prereqs/, ConfigMgrAutoSave.ini) on that one path. The directory is fully gitignored, and it is still host-side via the C:\vagrant synced folder, so the no-re-download property holds. Relocating it is a follow-up, not a prerequisite.

deps.description: AD schema extension tool for SCCM - ships inside the MECM media
deps.note: Extracted from the MECM media once it is staged, so it never needs its own download.

deps.description: Microsoft ODBC Driver for SQL Server - MECM prerequisite
deps.note: Same URL install-mecm.ps1 already uses, staged up front so the SCCM build does not stall on it.
